name: facet
description: Build, check and call a specialized model for one narrow task, from your agent.

interface.shortDescription: A specialized model for one task, better than a frontier model at it
interface.longDescription: Describe a narrow, repeated job and Facet builds a model for it, checks every change against plain-language Expectations, and serves it through an OpenAI-compatible API. You approve each quote before anything runs.
interface.defaultPrompt: Make a Facet Task for this classification step and show me what it would cost to make it better
